## Appearance

Obed Abernethy is an unusual-appearing individual with an awkward frame, hunching shoulders, and warm brown eyes. He has lengthy, iron-gray hair that reaches his shoulders and has worn a thick, gentle brown beard continuously since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Obed Abernethy is a quiet, reserved, and extremely shy individual known for his bashful and timid demeanor. Uncommunicative and taciturn, he rarely speaks and often remains silent in social settings, though he is a patient and good-natured listener who appreciates talkative companions. Despite his general shyness, he can exhibit an astonishing, quiet stubbornness, tenaciously clinging to his own views rather than relying on logic or reasoning. He is also remembered as a wise and gentle elder who provided affection and understanding. Additionally, he experiences a deep-seated fear of women—with only two specific exceptions—as well as little girls and being surrounded by unfamiliar people.

## History

Obed Abernethy traveled to the [Alder River](../codex/places.md#alder-river) station expecting to collect an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on his farm, but he unexpectedly brought home an orphan girl named [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) instead. Although his sister [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) initially insisted on returning [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to the asylum, Obed quietly wished to keep her. He secretly visited [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in her room to persuade her to apologize to Mrs. Sowerby after a fiery argument, resolving the conflict. As [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) settled into their home, Obed offered her steady support and encouragement in her schoolwork. Noticing her poor wardrobe, he enlisted Mrs. Sowerby's help to buy and sew a stylish new gown with puffed sleeves for [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) as a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gift. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) received the top entrance exam results, Obed warmly congratulated her in the hayfield, and he later shared an emotional goodbye with her when she departed for Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy). After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returned home from her studies, Obed suffered from failing health. Upon receiving news that their savings bank had failed, Obed collapsed and died.

## Quotes

> "Indeed, she failed to do so. The girl was brought by her. This was confirmed by my query to the stationmaster. Consequently, bringing her back fell upon me. Leaving her at that place was impossible, regardless of how the error originated."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0005)

> "Young Tobias Buote from the Creek came by earlier today, and I informed him that I thought I would take him on for the summer season."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P43](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0043)

> "I suppose she should receive a bit of punishment. However, Thirza, refrain from being overly strict with her. Keep in mind that she has never possessed anybody to instruct her properly. You—you intend to provide her with food, do you not?"
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003)

> "You realize it is bound to happen eventually, because Thirza possesses a terrible resolve—a terrible resolve, Nell. My advice is to perform it immediately and get it done."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)

> "Indeed—you are correct, Nell. However, keep Thirza from knowing I mentioned a word regarding it. She could believe I was meddling, and I gave my word to refrain from doing so."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--obed-abernethy.md)

Obed serves as a beloved friend, guardian, and father figure to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), living alongside her at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Though he and his sister were initially shocked when an orphan girl arrived instead of the boy they expected, Obed was immediately reluctant to send her back. He quietly supported keeping her, gifted her chocolates, and secretly visited her room to gently persuade her to apologize after an outburst, helping ensure she could stay.

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/obed-abernethy--thirza-abernethy.md)

Obed and [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) are brother and sister who live together at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and raised [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Though they collaborate on running the household and managing Nell's upbringing, they initially clashed over the child's fate; [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) firmly insisted on sending [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back to the asylum while Obed harbored a quiet desire to keep her. Despite these differing approaches to discipline and household decisions, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) keeps Obed informed of her plans and eventually admits to him that she, too, has grown fond of the girl.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), +26 more_
